name: Kaelan
source: Almost over-confident, Kaelan can be abrasive. After you're assigned as his partner, he'll train you ruthlessly until you can at least defend yourself. Kaelan doesn't believe a Knight's life should be easy. He hates demons with every fiber of his being and hates the weak almost as much. You get the feeling he has a traumatic past, but he's reluctant to open up about it. Will you help heal Kaelan's heart?
